_comment: Needed only where a folder's name cannot identify the blank on its own.
AXISM folders carry their style number ('7010 — DRI EASE OVERSIZED TEE') and
match automatically. Cotton Collective's do not: 'SPECIAL HOODIE 14 OZ' is the
catalog's 'Garment-Wash Hoodie 14oz', and nothing but a human can connect those.
Run the sync with no flags to have unmatched folders printed in this format.
